take_screenshot.description: Take a screenshot of any page in a real browser: the visible part or the whole page, or one element of it, as PNG or JPEG, on a phone, tablet or desktop, in light or dark mode, optionally framed in a browser window. Clicks, waits and hidden elements prepare the page first. Returns a public link and saves the image as a file.

parameters.description: The page to open, e.g. https://github.com/microlinkhq. An address without http:// or https:// is opened as https.
parameters.name: url

parameters.description: Capture the whole page from top to bottom, not just what fits on the screen.
parameters.name: full_page

parameters.description: PNG by default. JPEG makes a smaller file.
parameters.name: format

parameters.description: Optional. From 1 to 100, for a JPEG only: lower is a smaller file with more blur. 80 by default.
parameters.name: quality

parameters.description: Optional. A CSS selector to capture just one part of the page, e.g. '#pricing' or 'main'. Microlink waits for it to appear.
parameters.name: element

parameters.description: The device to look like: its screen size, pixel density and browser. Macbook Pro 13 by default.
parameters.name: device

parameters.description: Show the page in light or dark mode, for sites that have both.

parameters.description: Show the screenshot inside a light or dark browser window, for a presentation or a social post.

parameters.description: Optional. A CSS selector of something to click before capturing, e.g. a cookie banner's accept button, '#accept-cookies'.
parameters.name: click

parameters.description: Optional. CSS selectors of things to hide, separated by commas, e.g. 'header, .chat-widget'.
parameters.name: hide

parameters.description: Optional. A CSS selector to wait for before going on, e.g. 'main' or '.price', for content that appears after the page loads.

description: Open any web page in a real browser on Microlink's servers and get what you need from it: the metadata a link preview shows, a screenshot, a PDF or a short video, its content as Markdown, text or HTML, values picked out with CSS selectors, its links, images and email addresses, its logo, video and audio, its embed code, the technologies it is built with, a Lighthouse audit, or what your own JavaScript returns. Works without an API key on Microlink's free plan, whose 25 requests a day are shared across Lodol; add a Pro key for requests of your own.
